protocol.purpose: Cost and infrastructure calibration, not held-out quality qualification
protocol.sampling: provider defaults; no cross-provider seed equivalence
protocol.ordering: serial, provider then suite then listed arm; not randomized
protocol.billingLimitNote: Between-trial stop, not a provider billing hard cap. Current in-flight usage may be unknown.
protocol.exclusions: No dropped failures or automatic retries. Previously used tasks are development data. No benchmark superiority or narrow noninferiority inference.

stopHistory.resolution: Corrected collector path to agent/output/events.jsonl; no model rerun

trials.collectionRecovery: Corrected collector path to agent/output/events.jsonl; no model rerun
